settings.description: Signature waves. Sculpted Air. Blue that makes an entrance.

settings.intro: A different expression of the TN family. Sculpted white curves wrap dark mesh, while black laces and visible Air define the Air Max Plus Drift.
settings.part_1_body: Silver-grey mesh and dark panels sit beneath the white cage. A monochrome upper with depth from every angle.
settings.part_2_body: Broad white curves wrap the upper, giving the Drift its distinct, flowing profile.
settings.part_3_body: Air windows punctuate the white midsole at the forefoot and heel.
settings.part_4_body: Dark tread and a sculpted midfoot arch ground the white silhouette.
settings.part_5_body: Black laces, a dark padded collar and the heel-side Swoosh complete this white-and-black model.

settings.heading: Two forms. One attitude.
settings.panel_1_body: The blue-and-white Air Max Plus pairs a gradient upper with slim white waves. The silhouette that opens the story.
settings.panel_2_body: The Air Max Plus Drift takes a different line. A broader white cage frames tonal mesh, with black laces and a small heel-side Swoosh.
settings.panel_3_body: The same white-and-black Drift turns over to reveal its dark tread, sculpted arch and contrasting white midsole.
settings.panel_1_specs: Blue gradient, Slim wave cage, White laces
settings.panel_2_specs: Sculpted cage, Tonal mesh, Black laces
settings.panel_3_specs: Dark tread, Sculpted arch, White midsole

settings.heading: Lines & layers
settings.row_1_body: A long, low silhouette with white waves moving across a blue upper.
settings.row_2_body: Bright white framing, translucent details and a dark outsole bring the layers into focus.
settings.row_3_body: White laces and flowing waves frame the blue mesh. A gentle turn brings the upper into view.

settings.story: Saturated blue. Deep navy waves. A bright white midsole. This darker Air Max Plus brings a different mood to the same flowing silhouette.
settings.specs: Blue upper, Navy wave cage, Visible Air
settings.details: Colourway: Blue / Navy / White | Upper: Dark waves over blue panels | Sole: White midsole, dark tread

settings.manifesto: White curves divide the blue panels. The same line carries from the forefoot to the heel, a small detail that holds the whole silhouette together.
